text: (correction to the brief, twice) The brief's "six Conflab-specific commands" undercounts the handlers and miscounts their kind. First correction, at contract-writing: `cli`, `server` and `iex` need handlers too (binary resolution is project-local; `config/.env` sourcing is ruled out of the framework and out of `run:`). Second correction, at the build: `which` and `precommit` were ruled here to be opt-in catalogue rows with config recipes -- but the all-dispatch fix (`e0ed389`) proved `which` MUST be a full handler, because its own argument surface contains the literal `all` and only a total shadow receives `all` verbatim; `precommit` follows as a handler for uniformity of the ported pair, and `build` (hv's doctor note: offered with nothing to run), `docs` (the surface outgrows the catalogue pair) and `db` (the ash shadow) complete the set. FOURTEEN handlers in the final shape, each with its reason recorded rather than absorbed quietly
